name: DAMIC Collaboration
notes: No institution/member counts found in any source fetched this session.

summary.plain: The team of physicists who ran the DAMIC silicon-CCD dark matter search, first at Fermilab and then at SNOLAB in Canada, from 2008 until around 2025, when the SNOLAB detector was repurposed as a test stand.
summary.technical: Collaboration that operated the DAMIC CCD-based direct-detection programme at SNOLAB (2008-~2025), continuous with an earlier Fermilab prototype phase and related to the DAMIC-M programme at Modane; per a 2025 SNOLAB workshop report, the original detector has since been repurposed as a background test stand.
